group_2_min

Source: R/clone_dis.R
group_2_min.Rd

Compute Average Minimal Pairwise Distance Between Two Groups

Usage

group_2_min(distance, group1, group2, k = 3)

Arguments

distance

A numeric matrix of pairwise distances (e.g., from `dist()` or `igraph::distances()`).

group1

A vector of row indices corresponding to group 1.

group2

A vector of column indices corresponding to group 2.

k

Integer. Number of nearest neighbors to average over (default: 3).

Value

A single numeric value representing the symmetric average distance between the two groups.

Details

Estimates a symmetric inter-group distance based on averaging the top-k smallest pairwise distances between two groups. This is useful for comparing cell groups or clone sets using a local-neighborhood approximation of intergroup proximity. If the submatrix between `group1` and `group2` has only one value, that value is returned. Otherwise, the function returns the mean of the average top-k distances across both rows and columns.
